q: A family consisting of father, mother, and their children is called a ____ family. (P1)
explain: A nuclear family is the basic domestic unit made of parents and offspring.

q: Your father's brother is your ____. (P1)
explain: An uncle is the brother of your mother or father.
hint: Brother of your father or mother.

q: Your mother's sister is your ____. (P1)
explain: An aunt is the sister of either parent.
hint: Sister of your father or mother.

q: The child of your aunt or uncle is your ____. (P1)
explain: A cousin is the child of your uncle or aunt.

q: Which of these is a place where we buy and sell food and household goods? (P1)
explain: A market is a central place of trade.

q: Where do sick people go to receive medical care from doctors and nurses? (P1)
explain: Hospitals provide medical diagnosis, treatment, and nursing care.
